description: Extract audio from video. Pull the soundtrack out of a video file. When the track can be lifted as is, nothing is re-encoded and nothing is lost. Accepts video/*, .mkv, .webm, .mov, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

bitrateKbps.description: Bitrate in kbps. Only used when re-encoding

format.description: Output format. «As is» copies the track without re-encoding when the container allows it

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: audio_extract
